chapter: Trent's band: Arkansas, Dallas and the Adolphus
title: Adding Chester Clark; where Holder came from and how he ended
summary: Chester Clark joins during the hotel run; Holder came from Muskogee and later lost both legs and returned there.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: BUT YOU COULDN'T GO, YOU WOULDN'T GO IN THE SAME, RIGHT ACROSS THE STREET, YOU MAY WANT TO COME BACK TO THE ADOLPHIS AT SOME POINT.
Well we were going over there but A.G. got (inaudible) opening nite.
OPENING NITE.
Yeah, opening nite.
WHILE YOU WERE IN THE ADOLPHIS, DID YOU HAVE ANY CHANGES, CHESTER CLARK WAS ADDED. DID HE GO IN THE BAND AT THAT TIME.
Yeah, we added Chester Clark.
NOW WHERE DID YOU GET HOLDER FROM? I FORGOT ABOUT HIM. YOU DIDN'T BRING HOLDER IN, BECAUSE WE WERE TALKING ABOUT SWAZEY. SWAZEY MUST HAVE GONE SOMEWHERE ALONG THE LINE.
Well, Swazey (inaudible) DIDN'T OPEN AT THE ADOLPHIS.
No, no, Swazey wasn't there. We got Holder out of MUSKOGEE, PROBABLY.
That's his home, he just died.
DID HE JUST DIE.
Yeah.
WHEN DID YOU HEAR ABOUT IT?
I got a letter from him.

FROM HIM, NO KIDDING.
And he left for Sheffield.
HIS FAMILY, I THOUGHT EVERYBODY HATED HIM. HIS FAMILY TAKE HIM IN, SOMEBODY TRIED TO CALL HIS WIFE OUT IN BAKERSFIELD, SHE DIDN'T WANT TO KNOW ABOUT HIM. HIS WIFE AND DAUGHTER SAID THEY WERE GLAD TO GET RID OF HIM.
Did he have another wife?
DON'T KNOW, BUT WHERE, HE WAS LIVING IN BAKERSFIELD THAT'S WHERE HE WAS LIVING ALL THESE YEARS.
He was.
HE FINALLY CAME BACK TO KANSAS CITY FOR A WHILE AND THEN HE WOUND UP BACK IN MUSKOGEE.
Yeah, that's right. Well, he had both of his legs cut off, and then they put him in the hospital. HE WAS A LOT OLDER TOO, WASN'T HE?
Much older.
BECAUSE HE HAD TO BE AS OLD AS ANDY. ANDY COOK, IF NOT OLDER.

I don't remember exactly how much older.
ANDY IS ABOUT 82 I THINK.
No Andy is about 80.
I THINK HE'S ABOUT 82.
HE'S AT LEAST THAT OLD.
